paper_choice_function_model_definition_s.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_choice_function_model C \iff \forall (X : Finset \alpha), C X \subseteq X

paper_definition_choice_label.tex_statement: (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha) (X : Finset \alpha) (x : \alpha) = paperChoiceLabel C X x

paper_ml_representation_definition_state.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (predicts : PaperPoolPredictor \alpha) (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_ml_representation predicts C \iff \forall (X : Finset \alpha), \forall x \in X, predicts X x \iff x \in C X

paper_q_acceptance_definition_statement.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (q : ℕ) (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_q_acceptance q C \iff \forall (X : Finset \alpha), (C X).card = min q card

paper_total_order_definition_statement.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [DecidableEq \alpha] (r : \alpha \to \alpha \to Prop), paper_definition_total_order r \iff (\forall (x : \alpha), \lnotr x x) \land (\forall {x y z : \alpha}, r x y \to r y z \to r x z) \land \forall {x y : \alpha}, x \ne y \to r x y \lor r y x

paper_q_representativeness_definition_st.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (q : ℕ) (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_q_representativeness q C \iff \exists r, paper_definition_total_order r \land paper_definition_q_acceptance q C \land \forall {X : Finset \alpha} {x y : \alpha}, x \in C X \to y \in X \to y ∉ C X \to r x y

paper_d_instability_definition_statement.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (d : ℕ) (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_d_instability d C \iff \forall (X : Finset \alpha), \forall x ∉ X, choiceDistance C X (insert x X) \le d

paper_tight_d_instability_definition_sta.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (d : ℕ) (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_tight_d_instability d C \iff paper_definition_d_instability d C \land \forall k < d, \lnotpaper_definition_d_instability k C

paper_variability_at_most_definition_sta.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] [inst_1 : Fintype \alpha] (m : ℕ) (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_variability_at_most m C \iff \forall (X : Finset \alpha), (paper_definition_borderline_set C X).card \le m

paper_variability_exactly_definition_sta.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] [inst_1 : Fintype \alpha] (m : ℕ) (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_variability_exactly m C \iff (\forall (X : Finset \alpha), (paper_definition_borderline_set C X).card \le m) \land \exists X, (paper_definition_borderline_set C X).card = m

paper_choice_label_formula_statement.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha) (X : Finset \alpha) (x : \alpha), paper_definition_choice_label C X x = 1 \iff x \in C X

paper_fixed_threshold_formula_statement.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (score : \alpha \to ℝ) (threshold : ℝ) (X : Finset \alpha) (x : \alpha), x \in paperFixedThresholdChoice score threshold X \iff x \in X \land paper_definition_fixed_threshold_predictor score threshold X x

paper_ml_fixed_threshold_representation_.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] {C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha} (score : \alpha \to ℝ) (threshold : ℝ), paper_choice_function_feasible C \to paper_definition_ml_representation (paper_definition_fixed_threshold_predictor score threshold) C \to paper_definition_zero_instability C

paper_rank_threshold_formula_statement.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (q : ℕ) (score : \alpha \to ℝ) (hinjective : Injective score), 0 < q \to \forall (X : Finset \alpha), \exists threshold, \forall x \in X, paper_definition_rank_threshold_predictor q score hinjective X x \iff threshold \le score x

paper_ml_rank_threshold_representation_i.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] [Fintype \alpha] {C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha} (q : ℕ) (score : \alpha \to ℝ) (hinjective : Injective score), paper_choice_function_feasible C \to paper_definition_ml_representation (paper_definition_rank_threshold_predictor q score hinjective) C \to paper_definition_d_instability 1 C

paper_ml_rank_threshold_representation_v.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] [inst_1 : Fintype \alpha] {C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha} (q : ℕ) (score : \alpha \to ℝ) (hinjective : Injective score), paper_choice_function_feasible C \to paper_definition_ml_representation (paper_definition_rank_threshold_predictor q score hinjective) C \to paper_definition_variability_at_most 1 C

paper_ml_rank_threshold_can_represent_ex.tex_statement: \forall (q : ℕ), 0 < q \to \exists score, \exists (hinjective : Injective score), paper_definition_tight_d_instability 1 (paperRankThresholdChoice q score hinjective) \land paper_definition_variability_exactly 1 (paperRankThresholdChoice q score hinjective)

paper_q_representative_forward_exact_sta.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] [inst_1 : Fintype \alpha] {q : ℕ} {C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha}, paper_choice_function_feasible C \to paper_definition_q_representativeness q C \to 0 < q \to q < card \alpha \to paper_definition_q_acceptance q C \land paper_definition_d_instability 1 C \land paper_definition_variability_exactly 1 C

paper_q_representative_converse_exact_st.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] [inst_1 : Fintype \alpha] {q : ℕ} {C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha}, paper_choice_function_feasible C \to paper_definition_q_acceptance q C \to paper_definition_d_instability 1 C \to paper_definition_variability_exactly 1 C \to 0 < q \to q < card \alpha \to paper_definition_q_representativeness q C

paper_variability_one_iff_single_order_s.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] [inst_1 : Fintype \alpha] {q : ℕ} {C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha}, paper_choice_function_feasible C \to paper_definition_q_acceptance q C \to paper_definition_d_instability 1 C \to 0 < q \to q < card \alpha \to (paper_definition_variability_exactly 1 C \iff paper_definition_q_representativeness q C)

paper_substitutability_definition_statem.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_substitutability C \iff \forall {X₁ X₂ : Finset \alpha}, X₁ \subseteq X₂ \to X₁ ∩ C X₂ \subseteq C X₁

paper_sequential_q_representative_variab.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] [inst_1 : Fintype \alpha] {qs : List ℕ} {Cs : List (PaperChoiceRule \alpha)}, Forall₂ (fun q C  =>  paper_choice_function_feasible C \land paper_definition_q_representativeness q C) qs Cs \to 0 < sum \to sum < card \alpha \to \exists m, 1 \le m \land m \le length \land paper_definition_variability_exactly m (paper_definition_sequential_composition Cs)

paper_monotonicity_definition_statement.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_monotonicity C \iff \forall {X₁ X₂ : Finset \alpha}, X₁ \subseteq X₂ \to C X₁ \subseteq C X₂

paper_consistency_definition_statement.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_consistency C \iff \forall {X₁ X₂ : Finset \alpha}, C X₂ \subseteq X₁ \to X₁ \subseteq X₂ \to C X₂ = C X₁

paper_zero_instability_definition_statem.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_zero_instability C \iff \forall {X₁ X₂ : Finset \alpha}, X₁ \subseteq X₂ \to choiceDistance C X₁ X₂ = 0

paper_independence_definition_statement.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_independence C \iff \forall (x : \alpha), (\forall (X : Finset \alpha), x \in X \to x \in C X) \lor \forall (X : Finset \alpha), x \in X \to x ∉ C X

paper_even_distance_iff_inconsistent_sta.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] {q : ℕ} {C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha}, paper_choice_function_feasible C \to paper_definition_q_acceptance q C \to (\lnotpaper_definition_consistency C \iff \exists X, \exists x ∉ X, 0 < paper_definition_choice_distance C X (insert x X) \land \exists k, paper_definition_choice_distance C X (insert x X) = 2 * k)

paper_no_consistent_positive_tightly_eve.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] {q k : ℕ} {C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha}, 0 < k \to paper_choice_function_feasible C \to paper_definition_q_acceptance q C \to paper_definition_consistency C \to \lnotpaper_definition_tight_d_instability (2 * k) C

paper_general_variability_at_most_defini.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] [inst_1 : Fintype \alpha] (m : ℕ) (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_general_variability_at_most m C \iff \forall (X : Finset \alpha), (paper_definition_borderline_set C X).card \le m \land (paper_definition_waitlisted_set C X).card \le m

paper_general_variability_exactly_defini.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] [inst_1 : Fintype \alpha] (m : ℕ) (C : PaperChoiceRule \alpha), paper_definition_general_variability_exactly m C \iff paper_definition_general_variability_at_most m C \land ((\exists X, (paper_definition_borderline_set C X).card = m) \lor \exists X, (paper_definition_waitlisted_set C X).card = m)

paper_lap_slot_below_definition_statemen.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [DecidableEq \alpha] {\sigma : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq \sigma] [inst_1 : Fintype \sigma] (w : \alpha \to \sigma \to ℝ) (s : \sigma) (x y : \alpha), paper_definition_lap_slot_below w s x y \iff w x s < w y s

paper_lap_same_slot_order_definition_sta.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [DecidableEq \alpha] {\sigma : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq \sigma] [inst_1 : Fintype \sigma] (w : \alpha \to \sigma \to ℝ) (s t : \sigma), paper_definition_lap_same_slot_order w s t \iff \forall (x y : \alpha), w x s < w y s \iff w x t < w y t

paper_lap_model_definition_statement.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] {\sigma : Type u_2} [inst_1 : DecidableEq \sigma] [inst_2 : Fintype \sigma] (X : Finset \alpha) (w : \alpha \to \sigma \to ℝ) (A : Assignment \alpha \sigma), paper_definition_lap_model X w A \iff paper_definition_lap_assignment_feasible X A \land paper_definition_lap_capacity_filling X A \land paper_definition_lap_objective_optimal X w A

paper_lap_assignment_choice_formula_stat.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] {\sigma : Type u_2} [inst_1 : DecidableEq \sigma] [inst_2 : Fintype \sigma] (select : Finset \alpha \to Assignment \alpha \sigma) (X : Finset \alpha) (x : \alpha), x \in paper_definition_lap_choice_rule select X \iff paper_definition_lap_assigned (select X) x

paper_lap_assigned_strictly_outranks_rej.tex_statement: \forall {\alpha : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq \alpha] {\sigma : Type u_2} [inst_1 : DecidableEq \sigma] [inst_2 : Fintype \sigma] {X : Finset \alpha} {w : \alpha \to \sigma \to ℝ} {A : Assignment \alpha \sigma}, paper_definition_lap_objective_optimal X w A \to paper_definition_lap_capacity_filling X A \to paper_definition_lap_assignment_feasible X A \to \forall {s : \sigma} {y x : \alpha}, matchSlot s = some y \to Rejected X A x \to SlotNoTies w s \to paper_definition_lap_slot_below w s x y
